row.title: FULLSTACK-1: repository, back end and public front end for every system
row.body: Every system is checked for all three parts by foundation/fullstack.py: check runs in checks, live runs daily in tenant-repos.yml. Verified by tests/foundation/test_fullstack.py. The second-tenant seed has a back end only and carries Q-FULLSTACK-second-tenant.
